question: Which specific zone is meant when the dwelling of the classes is prescribed?
premises: The dwelling of the classes has been stated.
That statement refers to a specific zone.
The zone is the Brahma-demonic part.
inference: The prescribed dwelling of the classes is in the Brahma-demonic part.
plain_english: When the dwelling of the classes is spoken of, it is meant to be in the part between the Brahma and demonic zones.
